name: agent-flow-study
description: Beta — a lightweight local companion that lays out your Claude Code agents as they branch, work, and hand off, right inside the editor.

enumDescriptions: Watch both Claude Code and Codex sessions concurrently (default)
agentFlowStudy.runtime.description: Which agent runtime(s) to watch. In auto mode, runtimes you don't use are harmless no-ops (no session directory = nothing to scan).

agentFlowStudy.devServerPort.description: Port for the development server. Set to 0 (default) for production mode, or 3002 for development.

agentFlowStudy.eventLogPath.description: Path to JSONL event log file to watch for agent events

agentFlowStudy.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the visualizer when an agent session starts

agentFlowStudy.studyStorage.enabled.description: Study build: capture full local copies of Claude Code sessions for sharing with researchers. Informed consent is collected at study enrollment, so no in-editor prompt is shown. On by default so no session is lost; each workspace is captured to its own subfolder under a central '~/.agent-flow-study' home (kept out of your repos, survives uninstall). Set to false to pause capture.

agentFlowStudy.studyStorage.path.description: Override the capture folder. Empty (default) = a per-workspace subfolder under '~/.agent-flow-study'. A non-empty path (relative to the workspace) is used as the exact capture folder for this workspace instead.

agentFlowStudy.studyStorage.participantI.description: Study-assigned participant id recorded in the capture manifest (not personally identifying).

agentFlowStudy.studyWebsiteUrl.description: URL opened by the 15-minute study-protocol popup ('record your steps on the study website'). Empty falls back to the placeholder baked into the app.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.enabled.description: Generate live, human-readable status lines under each agent ('guava is debugging server-side auth errors'). When on and an API key is set, a small model summarizes recent activity; otherwise a deterministic fallback derived from tool activity is used. NOTE: with a key set, metadata about agent activity (tool names, truncated argument summaries, file basenames, todo steps) is sent to OpenRouter — disclose this at study enrollment.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.apiKey.description: OpenRouter API key used to generate status lines. Precedence: this setting → the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable → a key baked into the build at package time (study VSIX) → the deterministic (no-network) summary. Leave empty to use the build's baked key.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.model.description: OpenRouter model id used for status summaries. Pick a small, fast, cheap model — e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, mistralai/ministral-3-3b, openai/gpt-5.1-nano, or anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 for the best phrasing.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.throttleM.description: Minimum interval (ms) between status updates per agent. Bounds latency lag and cost.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.endpoint.description: Override the chat-completions endpoint used for status summaries. Empty uses the OpenRouter default.

agentFlowStudy.statusSummaries.sendRawTe.description: Also include a short snippet of the agent's thinking/assistant text in the summarization prompt. Off by default (metadata-only) for privacy; enabling it sends more session content to the model provider.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:webview && pnpm run build
